description: Extract shared LLM-routing logic into BaseLLMRoutingDatasourceProcessor (single-inheritance base class extending BaseDatasourceProcessor); Google becomes a plain child; search_kb dispatches via a factory registry
restructure_note: Initially implemented as a mixin mixed into each processor alongside BaseDatasourceProcessor; reworked per review direction into a linear base-class hierarchy. The base additionally owns client, _index_name (KnowledgeBase-based, keyed on child INDEX_TYPE) and the generic _on_process_start — all previously duplicated in Google.

passing_test.note: Google behavior assertions UNCHANGED — only mock-patch target strings retargeted (bulk, datetime, ElasticSearchClient now resolve in base_llm_routing_processor). Two registry tests cover factory selection.
